claims.statement: SilverSea is a TingTing-platform deployment customized for the SilverSea container-trucking customer; local ports are backend 3001, frontend 7174 (strictPort), Postgres 5441, Redis 6391, Adminer 8083, and demo mode is permanently disabled.
The O2C state machine is NEW → DISPATCHED → IN_TRANSIT → COMPLETED with CANCELED as exception exit; docs/prd/QuyTrinhO2C.md is the canonical spec and diagram-based content is authoritative.

testplan/flows contains role-based regression flows with roles (CUS, DISPATCHER, DRIVER, OPS, ACCOUNTANT, ADMIN, CUSTOMER) and no hardcoded usernames; per-environment accounts resolve via testaccounts.txt with shared staging password Abc123.

GPS/telemetry and the AI-assistant feature were removed entirely on 2026-09-06, and the PENDING_EXPENSE_APPROVAL status and maker-checker flow were retired 2026-09-05; none of these may be documented as current.
